verses.original: Ἰδὼν δὲ τοὺς ὄχλους ἀνέβη εἰς τὸ ὄρος καὶ καθίσαντος αὐτοῦ προσῆλθαν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Idōn de tous ochlous anebē eis to oros kai kathisantos autou prosēlthan autō hoi mathētai autou
verses.literal: When Jesus saw the crowds He went up on the mountain and sat down His disciples came to Him
verses.literalPt: Vendo Jesus a multidão, subiu ao monte; depois de se ter sentado, aproximaram-se seus discípulos,

verses.original: καὶ ἀνοίξας τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ ἐδίδασκεν αὐτοὺς λέγων
verses.transliteration: kai anoixas to stoma autou edidasken autous legōn
verses.literal: and He began . . . . . . . . . to teach them saying
verses.literalPt: e ele começou a ensiná-los, dizendo:

verses.original: Μακάριοι οἱ πτωχοὶ τῷ πνεύματι Ὅτι αὐτῶν ἐστιν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν
verses.transliteration: Makarioi hoi ptōchoi tō pneumati Hoti autōn estin hē basileia tōn ouranōn
verses.literal: Blessed are the poor in spirit for theirs is the kingdom of heaven
verses.literalPt: Bem-aventurados os humildes de espírito, porque deles é o reino dos céus.

verses.original: Μακάριοι οἱ πενθοῦντες Ὅτι αὐτοὶ παρακληθήσονται
verses.transliteration: Makarioi hoi penthountes Hoti autoi paraklēthēsontai
verses.literal: Blessed are those who mourn for they will be comforted
verses.literalPt: Bem-aventurados os que choram, porque eles serão consolados.

verses.original: Μακάριοι οἱ πραεῖς Ὅτι αὐτοὶ κληρονομήσουσιν τὴν γῆν
verses.transliteration: Makarioi hoi praeis Hoti autoi klēronomēsousin tēn gēn
verses.literal: Blessed are the meek for they will inherit the earth
verses.literalPt: Bem-aventurados os mansos, porque eles herdarão a terra.

verses.original: Μακάριοι οἱ πεινῶντες καὶ διψῶντες τὴν δικαιοσύνην Ὅτι αὐτοὶ χορτασθήσονται
verses.transliteration: Makarioi hoi peinōntes kai dipsōntes tēn dikaiosynēn Hoti autoi chortasthēsontai
verses.literal: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness for they will be filled
verses.literalPt: Bem-aventurados os que têm fome e sede de justiça, porque eles serão fartos.

verses.original: Μακάριοι οἱ ἐλεήμονες Ὅτι αὐτοὶ ἐλεηθήσονται
verses.transliteration: Makarioi hoi eleēmones Hoti autoi eleēthēsontai
verses.literal: Blessed are the merciful for they will be shown mercy
verses.literalPt: Bem-aventurados os misericordiosos, porque eles alcançarão misericórdia.

verses.original: Μακάριοι οἱ καθαροὶ τῇ καρδίᾳ Ὅτι αὐτοὶ τὸν Θεὸν ὄψονται
verses.transliteration: Makarioi hoi katharoi tē kardia Hoti autoi ton Theon opsontai
verses.literal: Blessed are the pure in heart for they will see God
verses.literalPt: Bem-aventurados os limpos de coração, porque eles verão a Deus.

verses.original: Μακάριοι οἱ εἰρηνοποιοί Ὅτι αὐτοὶ υἱοὶ Θεοῦ κληθήσονται
verses.transliteration: Makarioi hoi eirēnopoioi Hoti autoi huioi Theou klēthēsontai
verses.literal: Blessed are the peacemakers for they will be called sons of God
verses.literalPt: Bem-aventurados os pacificadores, porque eles serão chamados filhos de Deus.

verses.original: Μακάριοι οἱ δεδιωγμένοι ἕνεκεν δικαιοσύνης Ὅτι αὐτῶν ἐστιν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν
verses.transliteration: Makarioi hoi dediōgmenoi heneken dikaiosynēs Hoti autōn estin hē basileia tōn ouranōn
verses.literal: Blessed are those who are persecuted because of righteousness for theirs is the kingdom of heaven
verses.literalPt: Bem-aventurados os que têm sido perseguidos por causa da justiça, porque deles é o reino dos céus.

verses.original: Μακάριοί ἐστε ὅταν ὀνειδίσωσιν ὑμᾶς καὶ διώξωσιν καὶ εἴπωσιν πᾶν πονηρὸν καθ’ ὑμῶν ψευδόμενοι ἕνεκεν ἐμοῦ
verses.transliteration: Makarioi este hotan oneidisōsin hymas kai diōxōsin kai eipōsin pan ponēron kath’ hymōn pseudomenoi heneken emou
verses.literal: Blessed are you when people insult you persecute you and falsely say all kinds of evil against you because of Me
verses.literalPt: Bem-aventurados sois, quando vos injuriarem, vos perseguirem e, mentindo, disserem todo mal contra vós, por minha causa.

verses.original: χαίρετε καὶ ἀγαλλιᾶσθε ὅτι ὁ μισθὸς ὑμῶν πολὺς ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς οὕτως γὰρ ἐδίωξαν τοὺς προφήτας τοὺς πρὸ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: chairete kai agalliasthe hoti ho misthos hymōn polys en tois ouranois houtōs gar ediōxan tous prophētas tous pro hymōn
verses.literal: Rejoice and be glad because great is your reward in heaven for in the same way they persecuted the prophets before you
verses.literalPt: Alegrai-vos e exultai, porque é grande o vosso galardão nos céus; pois assim perseguiram aos profetas que existiram antes de vós.

verses.original: Ὑμεῖς ἐστε τὸ ἅλας τῆς γῆς ἐὰν δὲ τὸ ἅλας μωρανθῇ ἐν τίνι ἁλισθήσεται εἰς οὐδὲν ἰσχύει ἔτι εἰ μὴ βληθὲν ἔξω καταπατεῖσθαι ὑπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: Hymeis este to halas tēs gēs ean de to halas mōranthē en tini halisthēsetai eis ouden ischyei eti ei mē blēthen exō katapateisthai hypo tōn anthrōpōn
verses.literal: You are the salt of the earth But if the salt loses its savor how . . . can it be made salty again It is no longer good . . . for anything except . . . to be thrown out and trampled by men
verses.literalPt: Vós sois o sal da terra; se o sal se tiver tornado insípido, como se poderá restaurar-lhe o sabor? Para nada mais presta, senão para ser lançado fora e pisado pelos homens.

verses.original: Ὑμεῖς ἐστε τὸ φῶς τοῦ κόσμου οὐ δύναται πόλις κρυβῆναι ἐπάνω ὄρους κειμένη
verses.transliteration: Hymeis este to phōs tou kosmou ou dynatai polis krybēnai epanō orous keimenē
verses.literal: You are the light of the world A city on a hill cannot . . . be hidden
verses.literalPt: Vós sois a luz do mundo. Não se pode esconder uma cidade situada sobre um monte;

verses.original: οὐδὲ καίουσιν λύχνον καὶ τιθέασιν αὐτὸν ὑπὸ τὸν μόδιον ἀλλ’ ἐπὶ τὴν λυχνίαν καὶ λάμπει πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ
verses.transliteration: oude kaiousin lychnon kai titheasin auton hypo ton modion all’ epi tēn lychnian kai lampei pasin tois en tē oikia
verses.literal: Neither do people light a lamp and put it under a basket Instead they set it on a stand and it gives light to everyone in the house
verses.literalPt: ninguém acende uma candeia e a coloca debaixo do módio, mas no velador, e assim alumia a todos os que estão na casa.

verses.original: οὕτως λαμψάτω τὸ φῶς ὑμῶν ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ἀνθρώπων ὅπως ἴδωσιν ὑμῶν τὰ καλὰ ἔργα καὶ δοξάσωσιν τὸν πατέρα ὑμῶν τὸν ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς
verses.transliteration: houtōs lampsatō to phōs hymōn emprosthen tōn anthrōpōn hopōs idōsin hymōn ta kala erga kai doxasōsin ton patera hymōn ton en tois ouranois
verses.literal: In the same way let your light shine before men that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven
verses.literalPt: De tal modo brilhe a vossa luz diante dos homens, que eles vejam as vossas boas obras e glorifiquem a vosso Pai que está nos céus.

verses.original: Μὴ νομίσητε ὅτι ἦλθον καταλῦσαι τὸν νόμον ἢ τοὺς προφήτας οὐκ ἦλθον καταλῦσαι ἀλλὰ πληρῶσαι
verses.transliteration: Mē nomisēte hoti ēlthon katalysai ton nomon ē tous prophētas ouk ēlthon katalysai alla plērōsai
verses.literal: Do not think that I have come to abolish the Law or the Prophets I have not come . . . to abolish them but to fulfill them
verses.literalPt: Não penseis que vim revogar a lei ou os profetas; não vim revogar, mas cumprir.

verses.original: ἀμὴν γὰρ λέγω ὑμῖν ἕως ἂν παρέλθῃ ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ ἰῶτα ἓν ἢ μία κεραία οὐ μὴ παρέλθῃ ἀπὸ τοῦ νόμου ἕως ἂν πάντα γένηται
verses.transliteration: amēn gar legō hymin heōs an parelthē ho ouranos kai hē gē iōta hen ē mia keraia ou mē parelthē apo tou nomou heōs an panta genētai
verses.literal: For I tell you truly until . . . heaven and earth pass away not . . . a single jot not a stroke of a pen will disappear from the Law until . . . everything is accomplished
verses.literalPt: Porque em verdade vos digo: Enquanto não passar o céu e a terra, de modo nenhum passará da lei um só i ou um só til, sem que tudo se cumpra.

verses.original: Ὃς ἐὰν οὖν λύσῃ μίαν τῶν ἐντολῶν τούτων τῶν ἐλαχίστων καὶ διδάξῃ οὕτως τοὺς ἀνθρώπους ἐλάχιστος κληθήσεται ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν ὃς δ’ ἂν ποιήσῃ καὶ διδάξῃ οὗτος μέγας κληθήσεται ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν
verses.transliteration: Hos ean oun lysē mian tōn entolōn toutōn tōn elachistōn kai didaxē houtōs tous anthrōpous elachistos klēthēsetai en tē basileia tōn ouranōn hos d’ an poiēsē kai didaxē houtos megas klēthēsetai en tē basileia tōn ouranōn
verses.literal: So then whoever breaks one of the least of these commandments and teaches others to do likewise will be called least in the kingdom of heaven but whoever . . . practices and teaches them will be called great in the kingdom of heaven
verses.literalPt: Aquele, pois, que violar um destes mínimos mandamentos e assim ensinar aos homens será chamado mínimo no reino dos céus; mas aquele que os observar e ensinar, esse será chamado grande no reino dos céus.

verses.original: λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐὰν μὴ περισσεύσῃ ὑμῶν ἡ δικαιοσύνη πλεῖον τῶν γραμματέων καὶ Φαρισαίων οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθητε εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν
verses.transliteration: legō gar hymin hoti ean mē perisseusē hymōn hē dikaiosynē pleion tōn grammateōn kai Pharisaiōn ou mē eiselthēte eis tēn basileian tōn ouranōn
verses.literal: For I tell you that unless . . . your righteousness exceeds . . . that of the scribes and Pharisees you will never enter . . . . . . . . . the kingdom of heaven
verses.literalPt: Pois vos digo que, se a vossa justiça não exceder a dos escribas e fariseus, de modo nenhum entrareis no reino dos céus.

verses.original: Ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐρρέθη τοῖς ἀρχαίοις Οὐ φονεύσεις ὃς δ’ ἂν φονεύσῃ ἔνοχος ἔσται τῇ κρίσει
verses.transliteration: Ēkousate hoti errethē tois archaiois Ou phoneuseis hos d’ an phoneusē enochos estai tē krisei
verses.literal: You have heard that it was said to the ancients Do not murder . . . and Anyone who . . . murders will be subject to judgment
verses.literalPt: Tendes ouvido que foi dito aos antigos: Não matarás; e: Quem matar estará sujeito a julgamento.

verses.original: ἐγὼ δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ὀργιζόμενος τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ ἔνοχος ἔσται τῇ κρίσει ὃς δ’ ἂν εἴπῃ τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ Ῥακά ἔνοχος ἔσται τῷ συνεδρίῳ ὃς δ’ ἂν εἴπῃ Μωρέ ἔνοχος ἔσται εἰς τὴν γέενναν τοῦ πυρός
verses.transliteration: egō de legō hymin hoti pas ho orgizomenos tō adelphō autou enochos estai tē krisei hos d’ an eipē tō adelphō autou Rhaka enochos estai tō synedriō hos d’ an eipē Mōre enochos estai eis tēn geennan tou pyros
verses.literal: But I tell you that anyone who is angry with his brother will be subject to judgment Again anyone who . . . says to his brother Raca will be subject to the Sanhedrin But anyone who . . . says You fool will be subject to the fire of hell
verses.literalPt: Mas eu vos digo que todo aquele que se ira contra seu irmão estará sujeito a julgamento; e quem chamar a seu irmão: Raca estará sujeito ao julgamento do Sinédrio; e quem lhe chamar: Tolo estará sujeito à Geena de fogo.

verses.original: Ἐὰν οὖν προσφέρῃς τὸ δῶρόν σου ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον κἀκεῖ μνησθῇς ὅτι ὁ ἀδελφός σου ἔχει τι κατὰ σοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ean oun prospherēs to dōron sou epi to thysiastērion kakei mnēsthēs hoti ho adelphos sou echei ti kata sou
verses.literal: So if you are offering your gift at the altar and there remember that your brother has something against you
verses.literalPt: Se estiveres, pois, apresentando a tua oferta no altar e aí te lembrares que teu irmão tem contra ti alguma coisa,

verses.original: ἄφες ἐκεῖ τὸ δῶρόν σου ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου καὶ ὕπαγε πρῶτον διαλλάγηθι τῷ ἀδελφῷ σου καὶ τότε ἐλθὼν πρόσφερε τὸ δῶρόν σου
verses.transliteration: aphes ekei to dōron sou emprosthen tou thysiastēriou kai hypage prōton diallagēthi tō adelphō sou kai tote elthōn prosphere to dōron sou
verses.literal: leave your gift there before the altar First go and be reconciled to your brother then come and offer your gift
verses.literalPt: deixa ali a tua oferta diante do altar, vai primeiro reconciliar-te com teu irmão e, depois, vem apresentar a tua oferta.

verses.original: ἴσθι εὐνοῶν τῷ ἀντιδίκῳ σου ταχὺ ἕως ὅτου εἶ μετ’ αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ μή‿ ποτέ σε παραδῷ ὁ ἀντίδικος τῷ κριτῇ καὶ ὁ κριτὴς τῷ ὑπηρέτῃ καὶ εἰς φυλακὴν βληθήσῃ
verses.transliteration: Isthi eunoōn tō antidikō sou tachy heōs hotou ei met’ autou en tē hodō mē pote se paradō ho antidikos tō kritē kai ho kritēs tō hypēretē kai eis phylakēn blēthēsē
verses.literal: Reconcile quickly - with your adversary while . . . you are still on the way to court Otherwise . . . he may hand you over . . . to the judge and the judge may hand you over to the officer and you may be thrown into prison
verses.literalPt: Harmoniza-te sem demora com o teu adversário, enquanto está no caminho com ele; para que não suceda que o adversário te entregue ao juiz, o juiz, ao oficial de justiça, e sejas recolhido à prisão.

verses.original: ἀμὴν λέγω σοι οὐ μὴ ἐξέλθῃς ἐκεῖθεν ἕως ἂν ἀποδῷς τὸν ἔσχατον κοδράντην
verses.transliteration: amēn legō soi ou mē exelthēs ekeithen heōs an apodōs ton eschaton kodrantēn
verses.literal: Truly I tell you you will not get out until . . . you have paid the last penny
verses.literalPt: Em verdade te digo que não sairás dali, até pagares o último ceitil.

verses.original: Ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐρρέθη Οὐ μοιχεύσεις
verses.transliteration: Ēkousate hoti errethē Ou moicheuseis
verses.literal: You have heard that it was said Do not commit adultery . . .
verses.literalPt: Tendes ouvido que foi dito: Não adulterarás.

verses.original: ἐγὼ δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πᾶς ὁ βλέπων γυναῖκα πρὸς τὸ ἐπιθυμῆσαι αὐτὴν ἤδη ἐμοίχευσεν αὐτὴν ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: egō de legō hymin hoti pas ho blepōn gynaika pros to epithymēsai autēn ēdē emoicheusen autēn en tē kardia autou
verses.literal: But I tell you that anyone who looks at a woman to lust after her has already committed adultery with her in his heart
verses.literalPt: Eu, porém, vos digo que todo o que põe seus olhos em uma mulher, para a cobiçar, já no seu coração adulterou com ela.

verses.original: εἰ δὲ ὁ ὀφθαλμός σου ὁ δεξιὸς σκανδαλίζει σε ἔξελε αὐτὸν καὶ βάλε ἀπὸ σοῦ συμφέρει γάρ σοι ἵνα ἀπόληται ἓν τῶν μελῶν σου καὶ μὴ ὅλον τὸ σῶμά σου βληθῇ εἰς γέενναν
verses.transliteration: ei de ho ophthalmos sou ho dexios skandalizei se exele auton kai bale apo sou sympherei gar soi hina apolētai hen tōn melōn sou kai mē holon to sōma sou blēthē eis geennan
verses.literal: If your right eye causes you to sin . . . gouge it out . . . and throw it away . . . It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for . . . your whole body to be thrown into hell
verses.literalPt: Se o teu olho direito te serve de pedra de tropeço, arranca-o e lança-o de ti; pois te convém mais que se perca um dos teus membros do que todo o teu corpo seja lançado na Geena.

verses.original: καὶ εἰ ἡ δεξιά σου χεὶρ σκανδαλίζει σε ἔκκοψον αὐτὴν καὶ βάλε ἀπὸ σοῦ συμφέρει γάρ σοι ἵνα ἀπόληται ἓν τῶν μελῶν σου καὶ μὴ ὅλον τὸ σῶμά σου εἰς γέενναν ἀπέλθῃ
verses.transliteration: kai ei hē dexia sou cheir skandalizei se ekkopson autēn kai bale apo sou sympherei gar soi hina apolētai hen tōn melōn sou kai mē holon to sōma sou eis geennan apelthē
verses.literal: And if your right hand causes you to sin . . . cut it off . . . and throw it away . . . It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for . . . your whole body to depart into hell
verses.literalPt: Se a tua mão direita te serve de pedra de tropeço, corta-a e lança-a de ti; pois te convém mais que se perca um dos teus membros do que todo o teu corpo vá para a Geena.

verses.original: Ἐρρέθη δέ Ὃς ἂν ἀπολύσῃ τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ δότω αὐτῇ ἀποστάσιον
verses.transliteration: Errethē de Hos an apolysē tēn gynaika autou dotō autē apostasion
verses.literal: It has also been said . . . Whoever . . . divorces his wife must give her a certificate of divorce
verses.literalPt: Também foi dito: Quem repudiar sua mulher, dê-lhe carta de divórcio.

verses.original: ἐγὼ δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ἀπολύων τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ παρεκτὸς λόγου πορνείας ποιεῖ αὐτὴν μοιχευθῆναι καὶ ὃς ἐὰν ἀπολελυμένην γαμήσῃ μοιχᾶται
verses.transliteration: egō de legō hymin hoti pas ho apolyōn tēn gynaika autou parektos logou porneias poiei autēn moicheuthēnai kai hos ean apolelymenēn gamēsē moichatai
verses.literal: But I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife except for sexual immorality brings adultery upon her And he who . . . marries a divorced woman commits adultery
verses.literalPt: Eu, porém, vos digo que todo o que repudia sua mulher, a não ser por causa de infidelidade, a faz ser adúltera; e qualquer que se casar com a repudiada comete adultério.

verses.original: Πάλιν ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐρρέθη τοῖς ἀρχαίοις Οὐκ ἐπιορκήσεις ἀποδώσεις δὲ τῷ Κυρίῳ τοὺς ὅρκους σου
verses.transliteration: Palin ēkousate hoti errethē tois archaiois Ouk epiorkēseis apodōseis de tō Kyriō tous horkous sou
verses.literal: Again you have heard that it was said to the ancients Do not break your oath . . . but fulfill your vows to the Lord
verses.literalPt: Também tendes ouvido que foi dito aos antigos: Não jurarás falso, mas cumprirás para com o Senhor os teus juramentos.

verses.original: ἐγὼ δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν μὴ ὀμόσαι ὅλως μήτε ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ὅτι θρόνος ἐστὶν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: egō de legō hymin mē omosai holōs mēte en tō ouranō hoti thronos estin tou Theou
verses.literal: But I tell you not to swear at all either by heaven for it is God’s throne
verses.literalPt: Eu, porém, vos digo que absolutamente não jureis; nem pelo céu, porque é o trono de Deus;

verses.original: μήτε ἐν τῇ γῇ ὅτι ὑποπόδιόν ἐστιν τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ μήτε εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα ὅτι πόλις ἐστὶν τοῦ μεγάλου Βασιλέως
verses.transliteration: mēte en tē gē hoti hypopodion estin tōn podōn autou mēte eis Hierosolyma hoti polis estin tou megalou Basileōs
verses.literal: or by the earth for it is His footstool . . . . . . . . . or by Jerusalem for it is the city of the great King
verses.literalPt: nem pela terra, porque é o escabelo dos seus pés; nem por Jerusalém, porque é a cidade do grande Rei;

verses.original: μήτε ἐν τῇ κεφαλῇ σου ὀμόσῃς ὅτι οὐ δύνασαι μίαν τρίχα λευκὴν ποιῆσαι ἢ μέλαιναν
verses.transliteration: mēte en tē kephalē sou omosēs hoti ou dynasai mian tricha leukēn poiēsai ē melainan
verses.literal: Nor should you swear by your head for you cannot . . . make a single hair white or black
verses.literalPt: nem jures pela tua cabeça, porque nem um só cabelo podes tornar branco ou preto.

verses.original: ἔστω δὲ ὁ λόγος ὑμῶν Ναὶ ναί οὒ Οὔ τὸ δὲ περισσὸν τούτων ἐκ τοῦ πονηροῦ ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: estō de ho logos hymōn Nai nai ou Ou to de perisson toutōn ek tou ponērou estin
verses.literal: Simply let your Yes be ‘Yes and your ‘No No Anything . . . more . . . comes from the evil one
verses.literalPt: Mas seja o vosso falar: sim, sim; não, não; pois tudo que passa disso vem do Maligno.

verses.original: Ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐρρέθη Ὀφθαλμὸν ἀντὶ ὀφθαλμοῦ καὶ ὀδόντα ἀντὶ ὀδόντος
verses.transliteration: Ēkousate hoti errethē Ophthalmon anti ophthalmou kai odonta anti odontos
verses.literal: You have heard that it was said Eye for eye and tooth for tooth
verses.literalPt: Tendes ouvido que foi dito: Olho por olho, dente por dente.

verses.original: ἐγὼ δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν μὴ ἀντιστῆναι τῷ πονηρῷ ἀλλ’ ὅστις σε ῥαπίζει εἰς τὴν δεξιὰν σιαγόνα σου στρέψον αὐτῷ καὶ τὴν ἄλλην
verses.transliteration: egō de legō hymin mē antistēnai tō ponērō all’ hostis se rhapizei eis tēn dexian siagona sou strepson autō kai tēn allēn
verses.literal: But I tell you not to resist an evil person If someone slaps you on your right cheek turn to him the other also
verses.literalPt: Eu, porém, vos digo: Não resistais ao homem mau; mas a qualquer que te dá na face direita, volta-lhe também a outra;

verses.original: καὶ τῷ θέλοντί σοι κριθῆναι καὶ τὸν χιτῶνά σου λαβεῖν ἄφες αὐτῷ καὶ τὸ ἱμάτιον
verses.transliteration: kai tō thelonti soi krithēnai kai ton chitōna sou labein aphes autō kai to himation
verses.literal: if someone wants to sue you and take your tunic let him have . . . your cloak as well
verses.literalPt: ao que quer demandar contigo e tirar-te a túnica, larga-lhe também a capa;

verses.original: καὶ ὅστις σε ἀγγαρεύσει μίλιον ἕν ὕπαγε μετ’ αὐτοῦ δύο
verses.transliteration: kai hostis se angareusei milion hen hypage met’ autou dyo
verses.literal: and if someone forces you to go . . . one mile go with him two miles
verses.literalPt: e quem te obriga a andar mil passos, vai com ele dois mil.

verses.original: τῷ αἰτοῦντί σε δός καὶ τὸν θέλοντα ἀπὸ σοῦ δανίσασθαι μὴ ἀποστραφῇς
verses.transliteration: tō aitounti se dos kai ton thelonta apo sou danisasthai mē apostraphēs
verses.literal: Give to the one who asks you and do not turn away from . . . the one who wants to borrow from you
verses.literalPt: Dá a quem te pede e não voltes as costas ao que deseja que lhe emprestes.

verses.original: Ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐρρέθη Ἀγαπήσεις τὸν πλησίον σου καὶ μισήσεις τὸν ἐχθρόν σου
verses.transliteration: Ēkousate hoti errethē Agapēseis ton plēsion sou kai misēseis ton echthron sou
verses.literal: You have heard that it was said Love your neighbor and Hate your enemy
verses.literalPt: Tendes ouvido que foi dito: Amarás o teu próximo e aborrecerás o teu inimigo.

verses.original: ἐγὼ δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν ἀγαπᾶτε τοὺς ἐχθροὺς ὑμῶν καὶ προσεύχεσθε ὑπὲρ τῶν διωκόντων ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: egō de legō hymin agapate tous echthrous hymōn kai proseuchesthe hyper tōn diōkontōn hymas
verses.literal: But I tell you love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you
verses.literalPt: Eu, porém, vos digo: Amai os vossos inimigos e orai pelos que vos perseguem,

verses.original: ὅπως γένησθε υἱοὶ τοῦ Πατρὸς ὑμῶν τοῦ ἐν οὐρανοῖς ὅτι τὸν ἥλιον αὐτοῦ ἀνατέλλει ἐπὶ πονηροὺς καὶ ἀγαθοὺς καὶ βρέχει ἐπὶ δικαίους καὶ ἀδίκους
verses.transliteration: hopōs genēsthe huioi tou Patros hymōn tou en ouranois hoti ton hēlion autou anatellei epi ponērous kai agathous kai brechei epi dikaious kai adikous
verses.literal: that you may be sons of your Father in heaven He causes His sun to rise on the evil and the good and sends rain on the righteous and the unrighteous
verses.literalPt: para que vos torneis filhos de vosso Pai, que está nos céus, porque ele faz nascer o seu sol sobre maus e bons e vir chuvas sobre justos e injustos.

verses.original: ἐὰν γὰρ ἀγαπήσητε τοὺς ἀγαπῶντας ὑμᾶς τίνα μισθὸν ἔχετε οὐχὶ καὶ οἱ τελῶναι τὸ αὐτὸ ποιοῦσιν
verses.transliteration: ean gar agapēsēte tous agapōntas hymas tina misthon echete ouchi kai hoi telōnai to auto poiousin
verses.literal: If you love those who love you what reward will you get Do not even tax collectors do the same
verses.literalPt: Pois, se amardes aos que vos amam, que recompensa tendes? Não fazem os publicanos também o mesmo?

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν ἀσπάσησθε τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ὑμῶν μόνον τί περισσὸν ποιεῖτε οὐχὶ καὶ οἱ ἐθνικοὶ τὸ αὐτὸ ποιοῦσιν
verses.transliteration: kai ean aspasēsthe tous adelphous hymōn monon ti perisson poieite ouchi kai hoi ethnikoi to auto poiousin
verses.literal: And if you greet only your brothers what are you doing more than others Do not even Gentiles do the same
verses.literalPt: Se saudardes somente aos vossos irmãos, que fazeis de especial? Não fazem os gentios também o mesmo?

verses.original: Ἔσεσθε οὖν ὑμεῖς τέλειοι ὡς ὁ Πατὴρ ὑμῶν ὁ οὐράνιος τέλειός ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: Esesthe oun hymeis teleioi hōs ho Patēr hymōn ho ouranios teleios estin
verses.literal: Be perfect therefore as your heavenly Father is perfect
verses.literalPt: Sede vós, pois, perfeitos como vosso Pai celestial é perfeito.
